# webtables/len

> Length: of a `str` (its first word) or a slice (the header's second word).

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/len.pkg) · translates [std/len](../std/len.md)

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when x str`

```nasm
(i64.load (i32.wrap_i64
{x}
))
```

### `emit`

```nasm
(i64.load offset=8 (i32.wrap_i64
{x}
))
```
